propositions: Pure intercepts like verify-commit-ticket dispatch before centralized mount and skip store initialization, causing 'ticket store not found' errors in fresh linked worktrees.
Store mount logic is replicated per dispatch-arm and entirely skipped by pure intercepts, making the 'command forgot to mount store' bug structurally possible.
Mount gate must run at single central CLI choke point before intercepts and set-based dispatch to guarantee every store-touching command mounts the store.
Commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must not be force-mounted and must continue working without a store.
Library and MCP intentionally do not auto-mount; they require explicit init_repo and assume a mounted store, and must remain unchanged by this centralization.
